_documentation: Single source of truth for the public calendar feeds AND the home-page event cards (#249). Two consumers: (a) `scripts/build-calendar.py` generates `calendar.ics` + `calendar/<slug>.ics` from the top-level scheduling fields (`uid`, `summary`, `description`, `start`, `end`, `location`, `url`, `organizer`, `categories`, `status`); see `docs/architecture.md` *Adding a new event*. (b) The inline JS renderer in `index.html` (+ FR + DE) reads the *renderer* fields (`eventType`, `featured`, `displayDate`, `i18n`, `meta`, `cta`) to build the event cards on the home page. EN content comes from the canonical top-level `summary` + `description` (also used by the .ics); FR + DE overrides live under `i18n.{fr,de}`. The renderer falls back to EN if a locale block is missing, and the hand-coded HTML in each home page is preserved as a `<noscript>`-style fail-soft fallback that the renderer empties on success. When you edit an event here: bump `dtstamp`, run `python3 scripts/build-calendar.py`, and confirm the FR/DE i18n blocks track any EN copy changes. CI runs the drift checker on every PR.

events.description:
Three days of training and mentoring for early-career researchers in European security: research presentations, individualised feedback from senior scholars, and structured mentorship. Open to PhD candidates and post-docs (within one year of defence) in strategic studies and international security, as well as SWAMOS / Euro-SWAMOS alumni.

Scientific Coordinators: Dr Silvia D'Amato, Prof Chiara Ruffa.

Full details: https://eiss-europa.com/NetSecSchool.html

cardDescription.en: Three days of training and mentoring for early-career researchers in European security: research presentations, individualised feedback from senior scholars, and structured mentorship. Open to PhD candidates and post-docs (within one year of defence) in strategic studies and international security, as well as SWAMOS / Euro-SWAMOS alumni. Travel and hotel reimbursement is available for 15 PhD students, and selected participants receive free access to the European Security Conference that follows.
cardDescription.fr: Trois jours de formation et de mentorat pour les chercheur·euses en début de carrière en sécurité européenne, présentations de recherche, retours individualisés de chercheur·euses senior et mentorat structuré. Ouverte aux doctorant·es et post-doctorant·es (dans l'année suivant la soutenance) en études stratégiques et sécurité internationale, ainsi qu'aux alumni SWAMOS / Euro-SWAMOS. Remboursement des frais de voyage et d'hôtel pour 15 doctorant·es, et accès gratuit à la European Security Conference qui suit pour les participant·es sélectionné·es.
cardDescription.de: Drei Tage Ausbildung und Mentoring für Nachwuchsforschende in der europäischen Sicherheitsforschung, Forschungspräsentationen, individuelles Feedback von Senior-Forschenden und strukturiertes Mentoring. Offen für Promovierende und Post-Docs (innerhalb eines Jahres nach Verteidigung) in Strategischen Studien und Internationaler Sicherheit sowie SWAMOS- / Euro-SWAMOS-Alumni. Reise- und Hotelkostenerstattung für 15 Promovierende, und ausgewählte Teilnehmer·innen erhalten freien Zugang zur anschließenden European Security Conference.

Chairpersons: Dr Julia Carver, Dr Sanne Verschuren.

events.description:
A NetSec Inclusiveness Target Country (ITC) Conference, supported by the COST ITC Conference Grant scheme. The format prioritises participation from researchers based in ITCs, with travel-grant support coordinated through the Action. Programme and registration to be published on the Action's website.

The ITC Conference Grant is one of five NetSec grant schemes; see https://netsec-cost.eu/grants.html for the full set.

events.description:
The Action's first formal Management Committee plenary, bringing together the MC representatives from the participating COST Member countries to align on workstreams, confirm Working Group leadership for the coming cycle, and elect any remaining roles. Followed by a Core Group working session.

Access is restricted to MC representatives, Working Group leads, and invited observers.

cardDescription.en: The Action's first formal plenary meeting, bringing together Management Committee representatives and Working Group leads to align on workstreams, confirm leadership for the coming cycle, and elect any remaining roles. The Action officially started on 10 October 2025; this is the first in-person plenary.
cardDescription.fr: La première réunion plénière formelle de l'Action, rassemblant les représentant·es du Comité de gestion et les responsables des groupes de travail pour s'aligner sur les chantiers, confirmer les positions de direction pour le cycle à venir et élire les rôles restants. L'Action a officiellement débuté le 10 octobre 2025 ; il s'agit de la première plénière en présentiel.
cardDescription.de: Die erste formelle Plenarsitzung der Aktion, die die Vertreter·innen des Management-Ausschusses und die Arbeitsgruppen-Leitungen zusammenbringt, um die Arbeitsstränge abzustimmen, die Leitung für den kommenden Zyklus zu bestätigen und verbleibende Rollen zu wählen. Die Aktion startete offiziell am 10. Oktober 2025; dies ist das erste Plenum vor Ort.
